_meta: Machinevertaling (nl naar en) van de eigen factcheck malaga-video van Factiz, eigen werk van de redactie (B82, B84), door claude-sonnet-5-5, eigenvertaling-v1; doublecheck/eigenvertaling.py, PLAN #37.8.

velden.kop: Video of a crowd stopping an alleged thief comes from Málaga, not Milan
velden.oordeel_zin: The video shows an attempted robbery of a jeweller in Málaga on 16 July, not a gang in Milan on 17 October [1] [4].
velden.bewering: A video shows Italians in Milan stopping a pro-Palestinian gang on 17 October.
velden.kort: Since 20 October a video has been circulating on X as footage of Italians stopping a pro-Palestinian gang in Milan [4]. The footage comes from Málaga in Spain, where local residents held a man who had tried to rob a jeweller on 16 July [1]. The riots in Milan on 17 October began at a protest against the high cost of living, and according to Avvenire the rioters carried no flag or political symbol [2] [3].
velden.tekst:
On the night of 19 to 20 October, at 02:07, a Dutch-language post appeared on X with a 79-second video [4]. The text speaks of gangs in keffiyehs in Italian cities and of Italians in Milan who refuse to be subjugated by the anarchists of "fripalestin" [4]. Below it are the hashtags #Milano and #17octobre [4]. On 18 November the post had been viewed 105,671 times [4].

The same video circulated in English a few hours earlier. The account Visegrád 24 posted it on 19 October at 23:07 as Italian citizens catching a foreign robber [5]. A French post of 20 October did the same, with a video of the same length [6].

The scene was not filmed in Italy. On Thursday 16 July, around 21:00, a man in Málaga tried to rob a jeweller on Calle Martínez Maldonado, El Español wrote a day later [1]. He fled on foot toward an accomplice on a motorbike, was tripped on the way and was hit by someone on a kick scooter [1]. Local residents then held him while the accomplice rode off [1]. A local resident filmed it [1]. The Policía Nacional arrested the man and was still looking for the second suspect [1].

There was indeed unrest in Milan on Saturday 17 October. A march of about 5,000 people against the high cost of living ended in riots around Piazza del Duomo [2]. Some of the demonstrators, mostly young people with covered faces, threw stones and looted shops [2]. Police arrested about fifty people [2] [3]. According to Avvenire the rioters were very young, dressed in black and carried no flag or political symbol [3]. Il Post and Avvenire write nothing about Palestinian groups [2] [3].

The post thus presents an arrest in Spain from three months earlier as a scene from the riots in Milan [1] [4]. The footage itself is real [1].
velden.niet_weten: We do not know who first gave the video an Italian explanation. The oldest copy we found was on X on 19 October at 10:40 p.m., but that post can no longer be seen, so we do not know what the caption said. We do not know who filmed the video in July.
nog_uitzoeken: What the oldest copy said, the post of 19 October at 10:40 p.m. It can no longer be seen.
tijdlijn: Attempted robbery of a jeweller in Málaga; local residents hold the man until the police arrive [1].
El Español writes about the robbery and the arrest [1].
A march against the high cost of living in Milan ends in riots [2] [3].
Visegrád 24 posts the video in English as Italian citizens catching a robber [5].
The Dutch post about Milan and 17 October [4].
A French post with the same 79-second video [6].
